title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Drops Final Trailer With Savage Hulk Battle and New Poster
excerpt: Sony and Marvel release the last look at Tom Holland's fourth Spider-Man film, confirming the movie takes place before Avengers: Doomsday and teasing a first-ever MCU Spider-Man versus Hulk clash.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • The final trailer for Spider-Man: Brand New Day was released on July 21.
  • The film is set four years after No Way Home and before Avengers: Doomsday.
  • Mark Ruffalo's Savage Hulk will battle Spider-Man for the first time in the MCU.
  • Spider-Man: Brand New Day opens in India on July 30 and the US on July 31.
Spider-Man: Brand New Day Release Details

Sony Pictures and Marvel Studios released the final trailer for Spider-Man: Brand New Day on July 21, giving audiences their last extended look at Tom Holland's return to the role before the film swings into theaters at the end of the month. A striking new poster accompanied the footage, putting the web-slinger front and center alongside The Hulk, The Punisher, MJ, Scorpion, Sadie Sink's still-unnamed character, and The Hand, with a sprawling New York City skyline behind them.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=mM2HFFDTBoQ

The trailer, which had already been playing in front of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey in cinemas, is reportedly the same footage now released online. According to scooper Daniel Richtman, Sony and Marvel are keeping their biggest surprises under wraps until the July 31 premiere.

Savage Hulk Returns for a First-Ever MCU Showdown

The trailer's most talked-about sequence features Spider-Man going toe-to-toe with Mark Ruffalo's Hulk in what marks the first cinematic Spider-Man versus Hulk fight in MCU history. Unlike the affable "Smart Hulk" audiences have seen since Avengers: Endgame, the footage shows the Savage Hulk — a rampaging, uncontrolled version of Bruce Banner not seen since Avengers: Infinity War. Hasbro's tie-in toy line has confirmed the Savage Hulk designation.

> **"Peter Parker now lives entirely alone after Doctor Strange's spell erased the world's memory of his identity."**

"Peter Parker now lives entirely alone after Doctor Strange's spell erased the world's memory of his identity."

https://x.com/DiscussingFilm/status/2079597430488666255

The confrontation appears to be triggered by an unseen antagonist who can jump into people's bodies and control them. Bruce Banner, now a physics professor at Empire State University wearing a gamma inhibitor device, warns Peter with a chilling instruction: "If you see me with this off, run." When the Hulk transforms, Holland's Peter responds with the already-viral quip: "I didn't know you could get that big."

"I think Destin [Daniel Cretton] has found a way to grow this franchise and to make the movie feel bigger, and to make the action feel more dangerous, and to make the stakes feel higher without sacrificing the emotion and the heart of what makes these characters tick."

— Tom Holland, Actor

Set Before Avengers: Doomsday

Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige confirmed to Collider that Brand New Day takes place before Avengers: Doomsday, while producer Amy Pascal clarified the timeline sits four years after Spider-Man: No Way Home. Peter Parker now lives entirely alone after Doctor Strange's spell erased the world's memory of his identity. His loved ones, including MJ (Zendaya) and Ned Leeds (Jacob Batalon), have moved on — both are shown as MIT graduates going about their lives without any recollection of Peter.

The trailer reveals that Peter's body is undergoing a "surprising physical evolution," including organic webbing that pushes through his wrist-mounted web shooters. He seeks out Banner for help suppressing his mutating DNA, asking, "Could you get rid of the bad aspects but keep the good?"

Punisher, Scorpion, and a Mystery Villain

Jon Bernthal returns as Frank Castle, The Punisher, with the footage suggesting Spider-Man entrusts MJ's safety to the vigilante as a mysterious new threat emerges. Michael Mando reprises his role as Mac Gargan, the Scorpion, last seen in Spider-Man: Homecoming nine years ago. Early footage shows Peter's eyes turning black as he aggressively dispatches Scorpion, hinting at the symbiote-adjacent transformation the trailers have teased.

Sadie Sink's character remains the film's biggest secret. Her face has not been clearly shown in any trailer, fueling widespread fan speculation. Theories range from a telepathic mutant to a future host of the Phoenix Force, though Sony has given nothing away.

The film's marketing campaign has already shattered records. The first trailer, released in March, became the most-watched trailer of all time with 718.6 million views in 24 hours, according to Variety, nearly doubling the previous record set by Deadpool & Wolverine. It crossed one billion views within four days — the first movie trailer ever to do so.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day releases in India on July 30 and the United States on July 31, with dubbed versions in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Malayalam. The film runs 2 hours and 25 minutes and carries a 13+ certificate. Directed by Destin Daniel Cretton and written by Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers, the cast also includes Tramell Tillman, Liza Colón-Zayas, and Marvin Jones III as Tombstone.
